page: Google Cloud Platform c4a-highmem-72-lssd is an arm64-based server instance belonging to the c4a server family. It features 72 dedicated vCPUs and 576.0 GB of RAM, providing a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. The instance utilizes dedicated CPU allocation to ensure consistent performance without resource contention. While the basic description notes 16 local SSDs, the primary local storage size parameter is designated as None, and there are no bundled GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Due to its arm64 architecture, this instance is designed to offer high resource density and qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive deployments compared to traditional x86 architectures. No benchmark data is currently available for this specific instance type, meaning performance characteristics such as CPU compression, memory bandwidth, and database operations must be evaluated manually.

The high memory capacity of 576.0 GB combined with 72 dedicated arm64 vCPUs makes this server type suitable for memory-optimized workloads. Appropriate use cases include large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, data analytics pipelines, and enterprise applications that require substantial memory footprints without GPU acceleration.
